result.summary: The home feed is mostly rendered correctly, but one section header shows a raw, unresolved localization key instead of a human-readable title. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated title (e.g. 'Popular right now'). The placeholder string is exposed to users above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the 'home_feed.popular_title' translation key exists in the active locale's string resources, and add a fallback to the default language so raw keys are never rendered in the UI.
